notes: v4.3 issue-pool task (starship/starship#7426). The agent gets the REAL starship prompt-engine tree (Rust, edition-2024 source style) at the parent commit, sees only the user-visible symptom (the maven module falsely activates in any directory that merely contains an .mvn folder, e.g. a user-level maven config dir holding only .mvn/maven.config, rendering an empty 'via' tag), and must reproduce, localise and fix it in src/modules/maven.rs + src/configs/maven.rs without being told the file, function, issue number or commit (the fix commit is not reachable from the clone and there is no network). The verifier plants the project's OWN regression test (the single test function the fix commit adds inside mod tests, extracted at image build time into /opt/golden, never vendored into this task tree; sha256-pinned) plus three authored hidden test functions (pom.xml-only dir must still trigger; .mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.properties-only dir must trigger with the wrapper version rendered; an .mvn dir holding only settings.xml must NOT trigger), recompiles the crate offline at 1 vCPU, runs the freshly built test binary DIRECTLY with the 'maven' filter so every maven-module unit test (parent's five plus the four planted) must pass, and demands explicit per-test ' ... ok' lines for every required test so neutralised/skipped runs fail. Provenance is enforced at the blob level (every tracked file except the two files the bug lives in must hash to the pinned commit's blob; no untracked non-ignored files; object store holds only the pinned commit) so a scratch file left behind, a reformat commit, or a sabotaged test file all fail. The over-fix direction is guarded: hiding the module entirely fails the pom.xml/wrapper hidden cases; a fix that only removes .mvn folder detection without adding wrapper-properties detection fails the wrapper hidden case; a fix that keeps .mvn folder detection fails the golden test and the settings.xml hidden case. Nop container scores 0 fast (no source change and no summary.md). Agent measures the real incremental rebuild at 1 vCPU (minutes) inside a 2400s budget with the binary and test harness prebuilt in the image.
